```python
def test_strlen():
    # Basic cases
    assert strlen("") == 0
    assert strlen("a") == 1
    assert strlen("hello") == 5

    # Strings with spaces
    assert strlen(" ") == 1
    assert strlen("   ") == 3
    assert strlen("hello world") == 11
    assert strlen(" leading and trailing ") == 22

    # Special characters and punctuation
    assert strlen("!@#$%^&*()") == 10
    assert strlen("\n\t") == 2
    assert strlen("a,b.c") == 5

    # Unicode strings
    assert strlen("héllo") == 5
    assert strlen("你好") == 2
    assert strlen("🚀🌟") == 2

    # Numbers as strings
    assert strlen("12345") == 5
    assert strlen("0") == 1

    # Longer string
    assert strlen("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz") == 26
    assert strlen("a" * 1000) == 1000

    # Repeated characters
    assert strlen("aaaa") == 4
    assert strlen("ababab") == 6

    # Mixed content
    assert strlen("abc123!@#") == 9
    assert strlen("Hello, World! 123") == 17
```
